subject: Re: Kickoff: dataset distillation (KIP) as a data-platform service
body:
Dmitri,

Resourcing picture:

Compute: KIP with convolutional kernels was originally done with large-scale distributed resources, and that's what our reproduction needs too. Ask is 64 Titan A100s in sustained best-effort for the kernel computations through May, then bursts for the internal-corpus distillation in June. If Titan preemption bites we escalate to a small Vulcan slice, but I'd rather not burn a reservation on this.

Staffing: Kaia 60% (kernel methods lead), Yara 40% (eval + finite-network transfer, she'll own the ConvNet training checks), Chiara 50% (pipeline + Corpus artifact plumbing).

Platform dependency: we're planning around the Corpus v2 migration freeze on 2026-07-10 — all distilled-set artifacts have to be registered in v2 before that date, or the Jul 20 integration readout demos against a frozen platform. Jun, cc'd so you can flag if the artifact-registration API won't be stable in time.

Bao
